title: When the Static Burns Revisited
author: Astrid Reyes
blurb: Jonah Ashgrove, the last human technician on an automated relay station, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
